prompt: Accounts need passwords. Add `Register(email, password)` and `LogIn(email, password)`, returning a bool, to `AccountService` in Accounts/AccountService.cs. Hash with `Rfc2898DeriveBytes.Pbkdf2` and a random salt from `RandomNumberGenerator`; never store the password itself. `App.BuildService()` in Accounts/App.cs must keep returning a ready service.
